text: Over the last 30 days, several visitors noted issues with crowding, which affected their ability to fully engage with the exhibits despite timed entry tickets. Some found the reliance on AI for interactive elements detracted from the experience, and a few mentioned confusion about the flow through the exhibits due to a lack of directional signage. There were also complaints about parking availability, especially related to large vehicles occupying multiple spaces. Additionally, some visitors experienced difficulties with ticket purchasing, including the inability to buy tickets on-site and problems with payment methods. Overall, while many appreciated the architecture and interactive features, these operational challenges impacted the visit for a number of guests.
